narrative.summary: owner() is a 5-of-9 Gnosis Safe reached in one hop (all nine signers are plain EOAs), with no Timelock and no delay. Its owner-only powers are setOwner, enableIrm, enableLltv, setFee (capped at 25%) and setFeeRecipient, so by Morpho’s immutable-core design it cannot withdraw funds from existing markets.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80 (pushed on-chain 2026-09-20), same 9 signers as the Base, Robinhood and Tempo Morpho Safes
narrative.detail: The owner Safe’s 9 signers are identical, at the same 5-of-9 threshold, to the Morpho Blue owner Safes on Base, Robinhood Chain and Tempo, so one committee gates all four deployments. Pushed on-chain 2026-09-20: that cross-ecosystem overlap is folded into crossExposureScore as a flat 80, where the within-Ethereum-L1 comparison alone would leave it at 100; composite is unchanged. The scorer compares the freshly read owner set against a dated snapshot of the committee and opens no second RPC connection. Scored with the same rule as the Base card (admin 65 for a threshold of 3 or more, timelock 0), so one protocol keeps one convention across ecosystems.
